Replace the open-coded implementation for reading the PCIe DSN with
pci_get_dsn().
Use of put_unaligned_le64 should be correct. pci_get_dsn() will perform
two pci_read_config_dword calls. The first dword will be placed in the
first 32 bits of the u64
column2: while the second dword will be placed in the

column1: upper 32 bits of the u64.
On Little Endian systems
column2: the least significant byte comes first

column1: will be the least significant byte of the first dword
least significant byte of the second dword. Since the _le32 variations
do not perform byte swapping
column2: we will correctly copy the dwords into the

column1: dsn[] array in the same order as before.
On Big Endian systems
column2: the most significant byte of the second dword

column1: will come first. put_unaligned_le64 will perform a CPU_TO_LE64
will swap things correctly before copying. This should also end up with
the correct bytes in the dsn[] array.

column2: fix a small typo in the netdev_info error message when the
